articles.title: 大风蓝色预警：新疆西藏等6省区部分地区阵风可达7至8级
articles.highlight: 预计11月1日20时至2日20时，新疆东部、西藏北部、青海南部、内蒙古中西部、河北北部、江西北部等地的部分地区有5~6级风，阵风7~8级。
articles.summary: 中央气象台于11月1日18时继续发布大风蓝色预警，预警时段为11月1日20时至11月2日20时。新疆东部、西藏北部、青海南部、内蒙古中西部、河北北部、江西北部等6省区的部分地区将出现5~6级风、阵风可达7~8级，同时渤海、黄海、东海西部及台湾海峡等海域将有7~8级、阵风9级的大风。这条预警对相关地区的出行、海上作业和设施防风有直接参考价值。
articles.failureAnalysis: 这是一条标准的气象预警信息，判断价值在于看准时间窗口和具体影响区域：陆上关注阵风7~8级，海上则要关注阵风9级，再据此安排出行和作业。
articles.sourceExcerpt: 中新网11月1日电 据中央气象台网站消息，中央气象台11月1日18时继续发布大风蓝色预警：预计，11月1日20时至2日20时，新疆东部、西藏北部、青海南部、内蒙古中西部、河北北部、江西北部等地的部分地区有5~6级风，阵风7~8级；渤海北部、渤海海峡、黄海北部、黄海南部偏西海域、东海西部海域、台湾海峡将有7~8级、阵风9级的大风。

articles.title: The US-China trade war seems to have subsided – but the sense of calm is misleading
articles.highlight: 平静的表象具有误导性：世界正悄然迈向一场规模可能空前的经济战，历史表明它可能外溢为真正的战争。
articles.summary: 文章指出，美中贸易战因停火而暂时降温，但两国都没有采取行动限制新的敌对冲突爆发。贸易战淡出头条并不意味着风险消失，世界仍在滑向可能规模巨大的经济战，并可能外溢为真实冲突。值得读在于它提醒读者关注低可见度但高影响的地缘经济风险。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键不是贸易战已经结束，而是停火并未改变结构性对抗；越是表面平静，越要警惕未被头条反映的升级风险。
articles.sourceExcerpt: A truce has cooled the trade conflict, but neither country has done anything to limit the outbreak of new hostilities Donald Trump ’s trade wars have largely fallen off the headlines. Fears of new tariffs flare up from time to time when the US president goes off the rails – for instance, threatening to end US trade with countries with which it has a deficit unless the Federal Reserve cuts interest rates. But the sense that the world’s two largest economies are plowing ahead into an overt economic conflagration has taken a back seat to other, more salient fears, about Trump ending American democracy, AI killing us all and stuff like that.

en.highlight: The sense of calm is misleading: under the radar, the world is marching toward an economic war of potentially epic proportions that history suggests could spill over into real conflict.
en.summary: The article says the US-China trade war has cooled because of a truce, but neither country has done anything to limit the outbreak of new hostilities. The conflict falling off the headlines does not mean the risk is gone; the world is still moving toward a potentially epic economic war that could spill over into real conflict. It is worth reading because it flags a low-visibility but high-impact geopolitical economic risk.
en.failureAnalysis: The key point is not that the trade war is over, but that the truce has not changed the structural confrontation; the calmer the surface looks, the more important it is to watch for escalation that headlines do not reflect.
en.title: US-China Trade War Looks Calmer, but the Calm Is Misleading

articles.highlight: 即兴是实时生成新颖且贴合情境的行动，见于音乐、舞蹈、戏剧、体育、教育与治疗，但其神经科学证据几乎全部来自音乐。
articles.summary: 该综述把即兴界定为实时生成新颖且贴合情境的行动，并指出它存在于音乐、舞蹈、戏剧、体育、教育与治疗等实践中。作者强调，目前多数定量神经影像证据几乎只集中在音乐即兴上。文章据此梳理跨领域的既有研究，并提出后续研究的方向。
articles.failureAnalysis: 由于定量影像证据几乎全部来自音乐即兴，将相关神经机制推广到其他领域尚缺乏直接数据支持。作为综述，其结论也受既有文献覆盖范围与各研究测量方法差异的限制。
articles.sourceExcerpt: 1 Neuroscience of Improvisation Across Music and Other Domains: A Survey and Outlook Levina Perzhilla∗, Muhammad Mahboob Ur Rahman ∗,Senior member, IEEE, Tareq Y . Al-Naffouri ∗,Fellow, IEEE Abstract—Improvisation (or Improv), the real-time generation of novel, context-appropriate action, occurs in music, dance, theater, sport, education, therapy, and professional practice. Its neuroscience, however, has been studied almost exclusively for music, where most quantitative neuroimaging evidence lies.

zh.failureAnalysis: 由于定量影像证据几乎全部来自音乐即兴，将相关神经机制推广到其他领域尚缺乏直接数据支持。作为综述，其结论也受既有文献覆盖范围与各研究测量方法差异的限制。

en.title: Neuroscience of Improvisation Across Music and Other Domains: A Survey and Outlook
en.highlight: Improvisation, the real-time generation of novel, context-appropriate action, spans music, dance, theater, sport, education and therapy, yet its neuroscience evidence comes almost exclusively from music.
en.summary: The survey defines improvisation as the real-time generation of novel, context-appropriate action and notes that it appears in music, dance, theater, sport, education, therapy and professional practice. The authors stress that most quantitative neuroimaging evidence is confined almost entirely to musical improvisation. The article maps existing cross-domain work and outlines an outlook for future research.
en.failureAnalysis: Because the quantitative imaging evidence comes almost exclusively from musical improvisation, extending these neural findings to other domains lacks direct empirical support. As a survey, its conclusions are also limited by the coverage of existing literature and by differences in measurement methods across studies.

articles.title: microsoft/TokenEconomizer
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 公开信息显示，microsoft/TokenEconomizer 是一个获得 3745 stars 且有近期公开活动的 GitHub 项目，定位为面向编码智能体的经验驱动黑盒成本控制。它的价值在于把 AI 编码代理的调用成本作为可管理对象，而不是只看功能演示。对准备落地编码智能体的团队，可重点观察其成本节省是否以代码质量为代价，以及接入和跨模型迁移难度。
articles.failureAnalysis: 经验驱动的黑盒控制通常需要足够多的真实调用样本来冷启动，面对模型、任务或团队变化时可能失效。编码智能体链路长且结果质量难统一，压低 token 成本可能损害代码正确性，或把成本转移到工程接入和调参上。项目目前仅有仓库描述和 star 信号，尚不能证明需求刚性、可复现收益和跨团队分发能力。

en.highlight: Microsoft's TokenEconomizer is a GitHub project with 3,745 stars that offers experience-driven black-box cost control for coding agents.
en.summary: Public information shows that microsoft/TokenEconomizer is a GitHub project with 3,745 stars and recent public activity, positioned as experience-driven black-box cost control for coding agents. Its value is to make the cost of AI coding-agent calls a managed concern rather than only a feature demo. Teams deploying coding agents should check whether savings come at the expense of code quality and how hard it is to integrate or transfer across models.
en.failureAnalysis: Experience-driven black-box control needs enough real-call data to cold-start and may degrade as models, tasks, or teams change. With only a repository description and star count, the project has not yet proven hard demand, reproducible savings, or cross-team distribution.
